name: King County, Washington (United States)
description: Dark green field charged with the county's former logo, a yellow crown within a ring.
history: King County is the most populous county in Washington, seated at Seattle. Originally named for Vice-President William R. King, the county was renamed by ordinance in 1986 for Martin Luther King Jr., and the crown logo, used on this flag from 1984, was replaced in 2007 by a likeness of Dr King; Wikidata dates the flag 1984 to 2007.
